Trackslist

A1 State Trooper
A2 I'm Going Down
A3 Point Blank
A4 I Fought The Law
A5 Thunder Road

B1 Hungry Heart
B2 Dancing In The Dark
B3 Cadillac Ranch
B4 Candy's Room

Runout groove etchings (vinyl) or inner ring text (CD)

Side A: RR-4-BS A
Side B: RR-4-BS B

Release info

Part 1 of a series of 3 parts, sold separately, printed in Germany in multiple versions, always using the same plates, the first prints were all released with a black and white cover, and numbered sticker, the first print was made in 100 copies with Clear Vinyl, then in 80 copies with Black Vinyl and subsequently in 33 copies in Multicolor Vinyl.
The second pressing came in a regular red-filtered cover with colored vinyl, then the third pressing in 200 numbered copies on Picture Disc.
There are also unnumbered copies of Picture Discs, which are advanced copies and therefore much harder to find.
